cast_dialogue.linea: The particle 'up' lifts everything, heroes: it finishes, improves, appears and completes. Feel its energy!
I woke up late, tidied up my studio, and while I was cleaning I came across my first camera.
I broke up with my old recipe book — I've ended up inventing my own ramen!
Cheer up, Ben! I'll pick you up at seven, we'll dress up, and we'll catch up over dinner.
I brought up four children and never gave up. And now, mis héroes, let me heat up the soup. Eat up!

inicio.definicion_pragmatica: Phrasal verbs with 'up' often express completion (eat up, tidy up), improvement (cheer up, fix up), appearance (show up, turn up) or origin (wake up, bring up). With pronouns, separable verbs split: 'cheer him up', 'clean it up'.

filas: eat up, clean up, wrap up
cheer up, fix up, dress up

reading.texto: Sofía woke up early and decided to tidy up her flat. While she was cleaning, she came across some old photos and cheered up immediately. She called Ben, who had just broken up with his girlfriend, and invited him to lunch to cheer him up. Kenji showed up with dessert, and they ended up talking about old times. When life gets messy, friends always help you clean it up.
